text:
neel: Quick sync on the "window proof" follow-up. I'm worried about cache churn when lots of tiny tenants hit the same finalization window. thinking about proof-sharding by tenant-prefix to keep per-shard work bounded. anyone see issues?

tara: shard by hashed tenant prefix sounds good. each window = multiple shard roots + an aggregator root. keeps single-tree builds manageable.

dj: privacy question: could tiny shard populations leak info through root changes? we only publish hashes but still worth padding small shards.

neel: agree. pad empty leaves with canonical zero-hash and optionally coalesce tiny tenants into a shared padding leaf to obfuscate churn. default privacy-on.

maria: storage: options: keep hot shard trees in a fast store (rocksdb/redis) for N windows or store only roots+index and reconstruct cold shards on-demand from per-tenant aggregates in S3.

tara: hybrid works: hot shards cached in-memory for recent windows, cold shards rebuilt lazily. adds recompute cost but saves space.

ops-bot: prototype note: expect ~200 extra writes/sec to proof-store during peak finalization in one region.

dj: API: expose `GET /proofs/{window}/root` and `GET /proofs/{window}/tenant/{id}`. verifier can use either global root or shard proof.

neel: signing: sign the global root and include signed shard-root list in the signed_manifest. verifiers can choose shard or global verification without extra signatures.

maria: late arrivals: publish versioned roots (v1, v2...) appended immutably. auditors reference window@version. also include a mutations.log with signed mutation-hashes for transparency.

dj: incremental builder: maintain per-tenant leaf-hash and update parent nodes instead of full recompute; cache intermediate nodes for hot shards.

neel: eviction: bounded cache per-region to avoid OOM on big rollups. ops needs eviction policy.

maria: cost estimate: hot shard trees for 30 days + cold recompute cost. will add telemetry for proof QPS and cache-hit rate.

tara: shard-size target: 1k-10k tenants/shard seems sensible to keep proofs ~10-20 hashes. I'll run sizing experiments.

dj: testing plan: unit tests for incremental updates, synthetic runs with tenant churn, and cross-region compare tests that inject bit-flips to simulate corruption.

auditor-bot: sample CLI: `ri-proof verify --root <root> --proof-shard <json>` => OK|MISMATCH|INCOMPLETE. `ri-proof history --window <ts>` lists versions and mutation-hashes.

maria: decision list for RFC: shard K target, padding policy, cache retention defaults, API contract, signed_manifest format, key rotation plan.

neel: volunteers: @maria store+api, @tara shard builder tuning, @dj verifier+tests. prototype 2 weeks, pilot 4 weeks. I'll update RFC w/ timeline and runbook for key rotation and emergency revocation.

maria: noted. will track metrics and add runbook checklist.

neel: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
